# WeaveResult

The thread that now holds what was woven, and whether it was new or an existing thread strengthened.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `thread` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md) | The thread that now holds it: the new thread, or the existing one that was strengthened. |
| `reinforced` | `boolean` | True when the loom already held this and the existing thread was reinforced instead of duplicated. |
